sara.k: Heads-up — doing a pass on the quarterly access review. Found a couple of caller roles with wide KMS grants that never show up in the audit pipeline. Can we discuss integrating KMS key usage into the entitlement sampling?

jay_riske: yep, we should. Do you mean feeding key usage (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign) into the recertification evidence collector? :eyes:

sara.k: exactly. Right now recert only looks at service ownership and last login. KMS ops would show actual key consumption and help drop stale grants.

marta-ops: quick note — KMS logs are huge and noisy. We need a filter for long-tail system calls (e.g., cross-account ephemeral rotates) so we don't flag legit infra patterns as stale.

sara.k: agreed. proposal: 30d active window + a 5% throughput threshold and then surface to recert. If below threshold and owner mismatch, mark for manual review.

jay_riske: sounds reasonable. Can we implement a precursor that tags keys with a "recert_evidence:yes" label when they meet the filter, so the entitlement engine can consume straight from metadata instead of scanning logs?

marta-ops: yes — we can synthesize a label via our log-translation job. Example rule I sketched:
```
MATCH event.name IN ("Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey")
WHERE event.timestamp >= now()-30d
GROUP BY key_id
HAVING count(*) > 0 AND (sum(event.bytes)/sum(total_bytes) > 0.05 OR count(*) > 50)
=> tag key_id with recert_evidence:yes
```

devops-bot: Reminder: tagging jobs run every 6 hours. Last run completed 2026-03-20T04:12:01Z.

auditor-jen: question — for keys used by ephemeral CI runners, the counts spike but ownership is svcacct-ci. How do we avoid certifying the svcacct as owner instead of the app team?

sara.k: good call. We'll add a mapping layer: svcacct usages that originate from CI shards get mapped to owning repo/team via our provenance table. If mapping missing flag for human review.

jay_riske: also we should watch for grants that only appear in KMS logs as 'GenerateDataKey' (used for envelope encryption) — that should count, but we need to correlate with storage objects to justify.

marta-ops: can add correlation by resource tag join (bucket/table id) — cost will go up but only for flagged keys.

sara.k: action items: 1) marta to produce filter + prototype tagger (ETA Tue) 2) jay to add recert_evidence ingestion in recert pipeline (ETA Wed) 3) jen to update reviewer runbook to include provenance mapping steps (ETA Fri).

jay_riske: I'll also surface a sample of 200 keys with low usage for pilot recert.

auditor-jen: ack, will prep runbook section and a checklist for reviewers (how to treat Envelope keys vs direct keys).

marta-ops: one more — let's ensure logs are redacted for PII when pulled into the recert index. I'll include that in the PR.

sara.k: cool, thanks all. If nobody objects I'll lean on these changes for the next recert batch. :thumbsup:

jay_riske: +1

auditor-jen: +1

devops-bot: Created task: SEC-1479 "KMS recert evidence tagging pipeline" assigned to marta-ops (due 2026-03-24).
